# Download the dataset from HF

## inspect the dataset
### choose survived column as target
### type of target should be categorical for the task but it is integer so convert it.


```{r}
library(mlr3)
data<-read.csv("C:\\Users\\mayan\\Downloads\\titanic.csv")
str(data)
data$Survived <- as.factor(data$Survived)
data$Name <- NULL
data$Sex <- as.factor(data$Sex)
task <- as_task_classif(data, target = "Survived", id = "titanic")
task
```


```{r}
task$task_type
task$target_names
task$feature_names
task$properties
```

# Use Task

## Predicting the survival of passesngers based the input features

```{r}
learner <- lrn("classif.rpart")
learner$train(task)
prediction <- learner$predict(task)
prediction$score(msr("classif.acc"))
```
